# filmopen_sharing

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

How a film is shared: the sync target a film names — Google Drive by the folder id in its manifest, or a folder of this computer kept in its preferences — the Google account it needs, the *Sharing* card of Settings that starts, shows and stops it, and the new-project dialog's cloud choice and director block. A feature package: it imports the sync, the Drive client, the state, the widgets and the words; the application imports it, and `filmopen_tree` for the new-project dialog.

**Flutter.** 12 files, 2,769 lines under `lib/`; 185 tests in 14 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_sharing.dart`.

### `lib/src/cloud_choice.dart`

- **enum `CloudProvider`** — The clouds a new project can be synced to (§9.2): FilmOpen Cloud and Google Drive now, iCloud and Dropbox to come.
  - values: `filmopen`, `drive`, `icloud`, `dropbox`
- **class `AccountSnapshotBuilder`** — Rebuilds with the account's public snapshot as it changes, a source installed meanwhile included (`accountSnapshotProvider`).
  - `const AccountSnapshotBuilder({super.key, required this.builder})` — Builds [builder] with the current snapshot, and again after each change.
  - `final Widget Function(BuildContext context, AccountSnapshot snapshot) builder` — What is drawn for a snapshot.
- **class `CloudOptions`** — Which clouds can take a new project now, and why each other cannot (§9.2): read from the account and the settings, never guessed — a balance not known is not a zero.
  - `const CloudOptions({required this.snapshot, required this.driveSignedIn, required this.driveConfigured})` — The options for [snapshot], with Google signed in on this machine where [driveSignedIn] and a Google client in the build where [driveConfigured].
  - `final AccountSnapshot snapshot` — The account's public state.
  - `final bool driveSignedIn` — Whether this machine was last signed in to Google (`Settings.driveSignedIn`).
  - `final bool driveConfigured` — Whether the build has a Google client.
  - `bool get signedIn` — Whether the account is signed in.
  - `bool enabled(CloudProvider provider)` — Whether [provider] can take the project now.
  - `List<CloudProvider> get available` — The clouds that can take the project, in the order they are shown.
  - `CloudProvider? selected(CloudProvider? picked)` — The cloud in effect: [picked] where it can take the project, else the first that can; null where none can.
  - `String? get filmopenReason` — Why FilmOpen Cloud cannot be chosen, as a code — `signedOut`, `balanceUnknown`, `noBalance` — or null.
  - `String? get driveReason` — Why Google Drive cannot be chosen, as a code — `unconfigured`, `signedOut` — or null.
  - `String? filmopenReasonText(AppLocalizations l10n)` — FilmOpen Cloud's reason as a sentence: the first radio's, which *Create* says where no cloud can take the project; null where it can.
- **function** `Future<String?> shareNewProjectOnDrive(SharingModel model, FilmProject project)` — Shares a new project on Google Drive and answers why it is not shared: the Sharing model's notice, `notShared` where the share ended with neither a notice nor Drive in the manifest, or null where it is shared (§9.2).
- **class `CloudChoice`** — The new-project dialog's cloud block (§9.2): *Sync this project to the cloud…?* and, checked, the four clouds, each disabled with what would enable it under it.
  - `const CloudChoice({ super.key, required this.snapshot, required this.sync, required this.picked, required this.onChanged, this.model, this.launch, })` — The block for [snapshot], over the application's [SharingModel] or [model] where a test passes one.
  - `final AccountSnapshot snapshot` — The account's public state, which the dialog follows ([AccountSnapshotBuilder]).
  - `final bool sync` — Whether the box is checked.
  - `final CloudProvider? picked` — The cloud the person picked, null until they pick one.
  - `final void Function(bool sync, CloudProvider? picked) onChanged` — Called with the box and the pick as the person changes either.
  - `final SharingModel? model` — The Sharing model whose Google sign-in Drive's button starts.
  - `final Future<bool> Function(Uri uri)? launch` — Opens a page in the browser — `url_launcher`'s by default, a test's own otherwise.

### `lib/src/drive_account.dart`

- **class `DriveAccount`** — The Google account of this machine as the sharing needs it: signed in or not, sign in, sign out.
  - `DriveAccount({DriveAuth? auth})` — An account signing in through [auth], or through a `DriveAuth` of its own over the app's link door.
  - `static void withhold()` — Withholds Google Drive from this process for good, before any account is made: an agent build's entrypoint calls it, so that no Drive client reaches the person's credential store (`DriveAuth.withhold`, §6.10).
  - `final DriveAuth auth` — The sign-in the account goes through.
  - `void bind(Ref ref)` — Keeps the account's hint, which the card draws, in [ref]'s settings (`driveSignedIn`) from now on.
  - `bool get signedInBefore` — What the card draws: the preference the last sign-in or sign-out left, never a read of the credential store.
  - `bool get isConfigured` — Whether this build has a Google client at all; without one the card says so and offers no sign-in.
  - `Future<void> signIn({Future<void>? abandon})` — Signs this machine in through Google's consent page in the browser, and sets the preference where it succeeds.
  - `Future<void> signOut()` — Forgets the tokens, the Drive folders' lookups and the preference; the files at Drive stay.
- **variable** `final driveAccountProvider` — The one `DriveAccount` of the application, made on first read and bound to the settings.

### `lib/src/sharing_model.dart`

- **class `SharingState`** — What the card shows of the open film's sharing, read from its manifest and this machine's folder for it.
  - `const SharingState.notShared()` — The film is not shared.

  - `const SharingState.onFilmOpen(String this.name)` — The film is shared on FilmOpen Cloud, as `<username>/<tag>`.
  - `final String? target` — `drive`, `folder`, `filmopen`, or null for a film that is not shared.
  - `final String? name` — The Drive folder's name, for a film shared on Drive; the `<username>/<tag>` of a film on FilmOpen Cloud.
  - `final String? path` — The folder of this machine the film is shared to, for a film shared to a folder this machine has chosen.
  - `bool get isShared` — Whether the film names a target.
  - `bool get folderNotChosen` — Whether the film is shared to a folder and this machine has no path for it.
- **enum `RecordResult`** — What became of recording a project on the account (§6.6, *The account's projects*).
  - values: `created`, `replayed`, `updated`, `refused`, `unreachable`, `notSaved`, `markerNotSaved`
- **class `RecordOutcome`** — A record's outcome and its safe code: the result's name, or the refusal's code.
  - `const RecordOutcome(this.result, {this.refusal})` — The outcome [result], with [refusal] for a refusal.
  - `final RecordResult result` — What became of the record.
  - `final String? refusal` — A refusal's code: `noFolder`, `manifestMissing`, `identityMismatch`, `recordMissing`, `readFailed`, `failed`, or the account's own.
  - `String get code` — The safe code: the refusal's, else the result's name.
  - `bool get recorded` — Whether the account holds the record and this device knows it.
- **enum `CloudShareStage`** — The stage a share on FilmOpen Cloud stopped at.
  - values: `identity`, `record`, `restart`, `manifest`
- **class `CloudShareOutcome`** — What a share on FilmOpen Cloud came to: ready, or the stage it stopped at and its safe code.
  - `const CloudShareOutcome.ready()` — The film is recorded and `sync` names FilmOpen Cloud.
  - `const CloudShareOutcome.failed(CloudShareStage this.stage, String this.code)` — The share stopped at [stage], for [code]; nothing after it happened.
  - `final CloudShareStage? stage` — The stage it stopped at; null where it is ready.
  - `final String? code` — Why it stopped; null where it is ready.
  - `bool get ready` — Whether the share went through.
- **class `RecordPullFailure`** — Why opening a recorded project's manifest stopped: the [stage] (`lookup`, `manifest`, `bootstrap`) and a safe [code] — a refusal's own, or, where [unexpected], the failure's type.
  - `const RecordPullFailure(this.stage, this.code, {this.unexpected = false})` — A stop at [stage] for [code].
  - `final String stage` — Where it stopped.
  - `final String code` — Why: `unsupportedProvider`, `driveUnconfigured`, `signInRefused`, `driveFolderAbsent`, `badIdentity`, a target's code, `manifestLength`, `manifestMd5`, `manifestNotText`, `notEmpty`, `badTag`; a type where [unexpected].
  - `final bool unexpected` — Whether nothing foresaw the failure: [code] is then its type.
- **typedef** `typedef CloudTargetFor` — Makes the FilmOpen Cloud target for `<username>/<tag>` [identity], which asks [accessToken] inside its operations.
- **class `SharingModel`** — The Sharing card's state and its actions on the open film, with the Google sign-in they need.
  - `SharingModel(this.ref, {required this.account, this.authTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 30), this.cloudTarget = _cloudTargetFor})` — The model over [account], reading the open film, the settings and the sync service through [ref].
  - `final Ref ref` — What the model reads the open film, the settings and the sync service through.
  - `final DriveAccount account` — The Google account the model signs in and out.
  - `final Duration authTimeout` — How long the model waits for the account to give it a client before it counts Google as unreachable.
  - `final CloudTargetFor cloudTarget` — How a recorded project's FilmOpen Cloud target is made ([pullManifest]): the real one at `kFilmOpenDomain`, or a test's over a stand-in.
  - `Stream<String> get notices` — Every notice as its code, as it is raised.
  - `String? get notice` — The last refusal or failure, as its code, until the next gesture or sign-in; null where there is none.
  - `String? noticeOn(FilmProject? project)` — The notice to draw on [project]'s card: [notice] where it is about that film or about no film, else none.
  - `RecordOutcome? get recordOutcome` — The last record's outcome, until the next gesture; null where there is none.
  - `RecordOutcome? recordOutcomeOn(FilmProject? project)` — [recordOutcome] where it is about [project], else null: a record of one film never stands under another's.
  - `bool get busy` — Whether a gesture is under way or queued: the card's buttons wait for it.
  - `bool get waitingForBrowser` — Whether a sign-in is under way, which [cancelSignIn] stops waiting for.
  - `SharingState stateOf(FilmProject project, Settings settings)` — Reads the film's manifest (`sync`) and this machine's folder for the film.
  - `({String provider, String location}) recordPlaceOf(FilmProject project, Settings settings)` — Where the account records [project]: its folder's path where it is not shared or shared to a folder, `FilmOpen/<tag>` on Drive, `<username>/<tag>` on FilmOpen Cloud.
  - `Future<RecordOutcome> recordProject(FilmProject project, {required String username, required String provider, required String location})` — Records [project] on the account as directed by [username], at [location] of [provider] (§6.6), queued behind the gestures before it.
  - `Future<bool> signIn()` — Opens Google's consent page in the browser and answers whether this machine is signed in when it is done.
  - `Future<bool> ensureSignedIn()` — Answers whether this machine holds a sign-in Google takes, opening the consent page only where it must.
  - `void cancelSignIn()` — Stops waiting for the sign-in under way, which answers false at once.
  - `Future<void> signOut()` — Forgets this machine's Google sign-in, queued behind the gestures before it.
  - `Future<void> shareOnDrive(FilmProject project)` — Shares the film on Google Drive, in `FilmOpen/<tag>` of *My Drive*.
  - `Future<CloudShareOutcome> shareOnFilmOpenCloud(FilmProject project)` — Shares the film on FilmOpen Cloud, as `<username>/<tag>`, the username the viewer's.
  - `Future<void> shareToFolder(FilmProject project, String path)` — Shares the film to the folder [path] of this machine.
  - `Future<void> stopSharing(FilmProject project)` — Stops sharing the film: removes `sync` from its manifest and this machine's folder for it.
  - `Future<DriveFile?> findDriveFolder(String tag)` — The Drive folder `FilmOpen/<tag>` of *My Drive*, or null where either folder is absent; **never makes one**.
  - `Future<String> driveFolderOf(ProjectRecord record)` — The id of [record]'s Drive folder, after the sign-in Drive needs: `FilmOpen/<tag>` found by [findDriveFolder].
  - `Future<String> pullManifest(ProjectRecord record, String parentPath, {String? driveFolderId})` — Makes `<parentPath>/<tag>` for [record], a project the account records on FilmOpen Cloud or Drive, from the manifest its target holds, and answers the folder's path; the ordinary sync fills it once it is opened (§9.4).
- **variable** `final sharingModelProvider` — The application's one [SharingModel], over its Google account: made on first read, and ended with the container.
